content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Insurance underwriter and annuity writer; it bears policy risk, unlike a manager earning fees on assets."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions for placing policies, not managing investment assets."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager running funds and separate accounts for fees on assets, sold to institutions and advisors."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Annuity and life insurance carrier, earning investment income on policyholder funds rather than advisory fees."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Financial data and analytics software sold by subscription; it does not manage client assets."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Asset manager running mutual funds and separate accounts for fees, serving institutions and individual investors."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Asset manager earning fees on client portfolios and funds, though focused on alternatives rather than equity and fixed income."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Health savings account custodian and benefits administrator, with fees driven by account and transaction activity."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates OTC trading venues and sells market data and disclosure services; not an asset manager."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment manager running separate accounts and pooled funds for wealthy individuals and institutions."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Software and outsourced back-office operations provider; it sells technology and services rather than managing investments."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage placing property, casualty and benefits coverage for commissions; a different business."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Affiliated boutique managers running funds and separate accounts for fees, sold through advisors and to institutions."}]}
